admissibility_rule.primary: converged_design5: DESIGN.md §5 as written — every time step g <= 1e-6 or residual-rule exit, initial fit g <= 1e-6 or relative residual <= 1e-10, every exit regular; plus rule certification / fast parity
admissibility_rule.secondary: converged_own_gtol: the same rule against each invocation's own gtol (1e-6 or 1e-3) — the flag the report carried before DESIGN §A13 (2026-09-19); kept as a labelled secondary column, defines nothing

detail.note: None when no two sets share a rule file; a pair that differs means the multi-set path perturbs a result

matched_rule_files_bitwise.note: two rule sets carrying the same rule file must give bitwise identical arms (DESIGN A8)

no_subject_dropped.note: a drop is a reported finding, not a failure of the job
